commanders: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen

strategy.primary: Bolas superfriends: cast Ravager for ETB discard, transform him into the Arisen (Training Grounds helps), then proliferate, copy and repeat loyalty abilities across Bolas and other planeswalkers.
strategy.secondary: Chain Veil infrastructure with Teferi gives deterministic loops; the Arisen's -4 reanimates discarded creatures and planeswalkers.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Flying
When Nicol Bolas enters, each opponent discards a card.
{4}{U}{B}{R}: Exile Nicol Bolas, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery.
+2: Draw two cards.
−3: Nicol Bolas deals 10 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
−4: Put target creature or planeswalker card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
−12: Exile all but the bottom card of target player's library.
